description: Pinned target repositories. Fetched into the cache (agent_eval.py fetch), never vendored. Chosen as mid-size, actively maintained projects in three languages myceliums parses: an application (fzf, Go), a library with many small modules (hono, TypeScript) and a library whose repository is dominated by docs and tests (fastapi, Python).

repos.name: fastapi
repos.index_note: docs/ (1,709 Markdown files in 13 languages) is excluded from the index: with it, `myc analyze` produced 23,941 symbols and its community detection had not finished after 13 minutes on the benchmark machine, before any embedding. The agent still sees docs/.
